flows.name: Discover Solo Studio on the landing page
flows.goal: Understand what Solo Studio is for and get started.

steps.userAction: The visitor opens the public landing page.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows what Solo Studio is for, how the private client, project and booking workspace works, and how to sign in or sign up and share the booking page.

steps.userAction: The visitor chooses to sign up or sign in.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the start of designer sign-up or sign-in.

flows.outcome: Nothing is stored; after refresh the landing page still explains the workspace and how to start and share the booking page.

flows.name: Designer sign up

steps.userAction: The visitor chooses to sign up.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty designer sign-up form.

steps.userAction: The visitor fills in the sign-up form and submits it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the account, signs the designer in, and shows the empty workspace home.

alternatives.condition: Required email or password is missing or not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Creating the account fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The email is already registered.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the email already has an account and offers to sign in instead.

flows.outcome: A designer account is created and signed in; after refresh the designer stays signed in with an empty workspace.

flows.name: Designer sign in
flows.goal: Sign back into the private workspace.

steps.userAction: The designer chooses to sign in.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty designer sign-in form.

steps.userAction: The designer fills in the sign-in form and submits it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website signs the designer in and shows the home dashboard with their own clients, projects and sessions.

alternatives.condition: Required email or password is missing or not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Signing in fails for a technical reason.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The email or password does not match an account.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the details were not recognised and offers to try again.

flows.outcome: The designer is signed in; after refresh they stay signed in and see their own data.

flows.name: View home dashboard

steps.userAction: The designer opens the home dashboard.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows today's sessions, follow-ups due in the next 7 days including overdue, and overdue tasks with overdue highlight, each linked to its client, project or session.

steps.userAction: The designer chooses a session, follow-up, or overdue task to open.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the related session, client, or project detail.

alternatives.condition: There are no sessions today, no follow-ups due this week, and no overdue tasks.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says everything is clear and offers to add a client, add a project, or set availability.

alternatives.condition: The chosen session, client, or project was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the item is gone and shows the home dashboard again.

flows.outcome: Nothing is stored; after refresh home still shows today's sessions, this week's follow-ups and overdue tasks.

flows.name: Add a client

steps.userAction: The designer chooses to add a client.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty client form.

steps.userAction: The designer fills in the client and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the client defaulting to Lead when status is not set and shows it in the client list with its follow-up state.

alternatives.condition: Required name or email is missing or not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The designer cancels without saving.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is saved; the website shows the client list as it was.

flows.outcome: A new Client is saved defaulting to Lead when not set and is still in the list after refresh.

flows.name: Track client notes and follow-ups
flows.goal: Keep notes and never miss a follow-up.

steps.userAction: The designer opens the client list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows clients sorted with overdue follow-ups first then by nearest date, each with its follow-up state.

steps.userAction: The designer opens a client from the list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the client details with dated notes and offers to mark a follow-up done or push it a week with one click.

steps.userAction: The designer writes a note with an optional follow-up date and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the dated note and shows it with the client, updating the follow-up order.

steps.userAction: The designer chooses Mark done or Push a week on a follow-up.
steps.websiteResponse: The website clears the follow-up date when marked done or moves it a week forward when pushed, and updates the client list order.

alternatives.condition: There are no clients yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no clients yet and offers to add a client.

alternatives.condition: The client was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the client is gone and shows the client list.

alternatives.condition: The client has no notes yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no notes yet and offers to add a note.

alternatives.condition: The note text is empty.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the note fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: Updating the follow-up fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the follow-up as it was and offers to retry.

flows.outcome: Notes and follow-up dates are saved; done clears the date and push adds 7 days; after refresh the list still sorts overdue first.

flows.name: Edit a client

steps.userAction: The designer opens the client list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the clients with their follow-up states.

steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the client name, email, company, profile and status.

steps.userAction: The designer changes the client details and saves them.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the changes and shows the updated client in the list and detail.

alternatives.condition: Saving fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is changed; the website shows the client again as it was.

flows.outcome: The Client is updated and stays updated after refresh.

flows.name: Delete a client
flows.goal: Remove a client and everything under it.

steps.userAction: The designer opens the client list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the clients with their follow-up states.

steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the client with its projects and notes and what else will be removed with it.

steps.userAction: The designer chooses Delete on the client.

alternatives.condition: There are no clients.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no clients and offers to add a client.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the client is gone and shows the client list.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows the client list without the client, its projects, tasks and notes.

flows.name: Book a session from the public page
flows.goal: Book a session without an account.
preconditions: Designer has set availability and session types.

steps.userAction: The booker opens the public booking page.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the bookable session types with duration and displayed price.

steps.userAction: The booker picks a session type.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the open slots for the next two weeks for that type, without other bookers names or emails.

steps.userAction: The booker picks an open slot and books with name and email.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the booking, links it to the client with the same email or creates a new Lead client, and shows a confirmation with a cancellation link.

alternatives.condition: No session types are available for booking.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says no sessions can be booked right now.

alternatives.condition: There are no open slots for the chosen type in the next two weeks.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no open slots for that type and invites the booker to pick another type.

alternatives.condition: Name or email is missing or email is not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the booking fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The slot just became full.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the slot is now full and shows the remaining open slots.

alternatives.condition: The slot no longer exists.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the slot is no longer available and shows the open slots.

alternatives.condition: No existing client matches the booking email.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website creates a new Lead client for the booking and shows the confirmation with the cancellation link.

flows.outcome: A Session booking is saved and linked to the matching Client or a new Lead Client; after refresh the slot shows as booked or full and the confirmation with link is retrievable from the booking.

alternatives.condition: The booker confirms cancellation.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows the booking is cancelled and the seat is freed.

fields.label: Designer email
fields.meaning: Email the designer uses to sign up and sign in

fields.label: Password
fields.meaning: Secret that proves the designer owns the account

fields.label: Client name
fields.meaning: How the designer refers to the client

fields.label: Client email
fields.meaning: Email used to match bookings to this client

fields.label: Company
fields.meaning: Optional company the client works for

fields.label: Client profile
fields.meaning: Short note about what they do, how met and what they pay
fields.example: Runs a D2C skincare brand, met at design meetup, pays per project

fields.label: Client status
fields.meaning: Where the client is in the relationship

fields.label: Note text
fields.meaning: What was discussed or decided with the client
fields.example: Call went well, wants homepage audit next week

fields.label: Follow-up date
fields.meaning: When the designer should next contact the client

fields.label: Project name
fields.meaning: How the designer refers to the work for a client

fields.label: Project description
fields.meaning: Short summary of what the project covers
fields.example: Audit and redesign of marketing homepage

fields.label: Project due date
fields.meaning: Optional date the project should be finished by

fields.label: Task title
fields.meaning: What needs to be done in the project

fields.label: Task status
fields.meaning: Where the task is in its workflow

fields.label: Task priority
fields.meaning: How urgent the task is

fields.label: Task due date
fields.meaning: Optional date the task should be done by, overdue when before today and not Done

fields.label: Availability weekday
fields.meaning: Which day of the week sessions can be offered

fields.label: Availability start time
fields.meaning: Time from which sessions can start on that weekday

fields.label: Availability end time
fields.meaning: Time by which sessions must end on that weekday

fields.label: Session type name
fields.meaning: Name of the bookable offering shown to bookers

fields.label: Session type duration
fields.meaning: Length of one slot in minutes

fields.label: Displayed price
fields.meaning: Price shown for information only, nobody pays in the app

fields.label: Max people per slot
fields.meaning: How many bookings a slot holds before it is full

fields.label: Booker name
fields.meaning: Name of the visitor booking a session

fields.label: Booker email
fields.meaning: Email used to link the booking to a client and to identify the booking

fields.label: Task search text
fields.meaning: Free text to find tasks by title

fields.label: Task status filter
fields.meaning: Show only tasks with this status

fields.label: Task priority filter
fields.meaning: Show only tasks with this priority

fields.label: Project client
fields.meaning: Which client the project belongs to

fields.label: Session type choice
fields.meaning: Which offering the booker wants to book

fields.label: Slot choice
fields.meaning: Which open time the booker reserves

steps.websiteResponse: The website asks to confirm the deletion and says what else will be removed with it.

alternatives.condition: The user confirms.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website deletes the record and what belongs to it.

alternatives.condition: The user cancels.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is deleted; the record stays as it was.

assumptions.text: Quick tick sets Task status to Done; unticking returns it to To do. Overdue highlight applies only to Tasks not Done whose due date is before today.
Each Booking gets a unique cancellation link shown on screen right after booking; the link works without sign-in and stays usable until the Booking is cancelled.
